title: Parking Report a Violation
categories: Parking, Vehicle, Bicycle and Scooter Concerns
description: Use this request to report parking violations on a public street, alley or sidewalk. Please use block numbers when entering vehicle location (i.e. 1300 Main). The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 4 hours.

observedQuestions.prompt: Is the vehicle parked on a public street/alley/sidewalk or private property?

branches.Public street/alley/sidewalk: Ask violation and vehicle details; show blocked driveway guidance
branches.Private property: Validation Alert: ** If vehicle is on private property use Code Concerns - CCS **

options: Expired Meter or Exceeding the Posted Time Limit
Facing Wrong side of the Road

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request about a parking violation on a public street, alley, or sidewalk.
actions.why: For parking violations on a public street, alley, or sidewalk, including posted-limit, wrong-way, no-parking, bike-lane, hydrant, and sidewalk obstruction concerns. The 311 request form asks for the violation and vehicle make, model, color, plate, and state; the description asks for a block number in the location.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Parking Report a Violation" requests does not apply to vehicles on private property or a blocked driveway. If the vehicle is on private property, then submit a "Code Concerns" 311 request instead. If a vehicle blocks a driveway without an emergency or freeway concern, then call 311 by phone instead of submitting a 311 request online.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Parking, Vehicle, Bicycle and Scooter Concerns" > Choose "Parking Report a Violation"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Parking, Vehicle, Bicycle and Scooter Concerns" > Choose "Parking Report a Violation"

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request about a vehicle on private property through Code Concerns.
actions.why: For a parking concern involving a vehicle on private property. The Parking Report a Violation form directs this answer to "Code Concerns".
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "City Code Violations" > Choose "Code Concerns"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "City Code Violations" > Choose "Code Concerns"

actions.tagline: Call Dallas 311 by phone about a non-emergency vehicle blocking a driveway.
actions.why: For a non-emergency vehicle blocking a driveway. The Parking Report a Violation form directs blocked-driveway concerns to "Street, Road or Driveway Blockage"; that service must be dispatched by calling 311.
